lanes.summary: The diff perfectly matches the acceptance criteria outlined in the ticket. It introduces a pure resolution step to verify the existence of the coverage job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` before any tags are cut or GitHub API calls are made. It correctly delegates the job name to a single function, ensures the gate refuses on unreadable or undeclared jobs with 'NOT_MEASURED' or 'FAIL', and appropriately mutates the check in `check_tag_step_gated.sh` to enforce this behavior. All criteria are fully implemented and verified by the included test assertions.

findings.claim: the coverage job name lives in one function
resolved against the jobs of .github/workflows/ci.yml at the release commit before any tag step
absent or renamed job = FAIL naming the job and the file, with 0 GitHub calls
unreadable/empty ci.yml, no jobs, or a reusable-workflow caller = NOT_MEASURED, which refuses
findings.fix:
if [ "$caller" != "$JOB" ] && awk -F'\t' -v c="$caller" '$2 == c && $3 != "-" { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' <<< "$jobs"; then
        echo "nm '$JOB' would come from inside the reusable workflow job '$caller' calls, which $CI_YML_REL does not show"; return
    fi

bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/release/tag_coverage_gate.sh" --resolve "$mc" >> "$LOG" 2>&1 \
        || die "the tag coverage job is not declared in ci.yml at $mc (tag_coverage_gate.sh --resolve) -- no tag, nothing carried"
    say "COVERAGE-JOB declared in ci.yml at $mc (tag_coverage_gate.sh --resolve rc=0)"
    bash "$REPO_ROOT/scripts/check_milestone_cut.sh" "$v" --must-carry >> "$LOG" 2>&1 || rc=$?

findings.claim: check_tag_step_gated.sh order row and two plants (call removed, die neutered) go RED
present + green passes; present + red refuses; gh failing refuses
findings.fix:
e2e 0 "e2e #4691: job declared and green on the tag passes" "$RUN_DONE" "$GREEN" present
    e2e 1 "e2e #4691: job declared and red on the tag refuses" \
        "$RUN_DONE" '{"jobs":[{"name":"ci / coverage","status":"completed","conclusion":"failure"}]}' present
    : > "$d/gh-fails"
    e2e 1 "e2e #4691: job declared, gh failing refuses (a failed read is not a pass)" "$RUN_DONE" "$GREEN" present

lanes.summary: The diff matches GH-4691's acceptance criteria and I found nothing that refutes it. Every criterion has a matching change or self-test row. I judged the recorded results and did not run any build or test. Against the real ci.yml the new gate refuses every release at cut_tag, because ci.yml has no `ci / coverage` job; that is what the ticket asks for, and the ticket notes it.

findings.claim: Behaviour change to flag, not a defect: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` declares no `ci / coverage` job (only x86-main, ci-gate named `ci / gate`, and others), so the new `--resolve` step in cut_tag refuses every release until a coverage job is declared or the gate is retargeted. The ticket's own notes say so. This is the intended refuse-before-tag outcome, but a follow-up is needed to unblock releases.
findings.fix: Open a follow-up ticket to declare the job or retarget the gate.
